sources.title: FastVLA: Task-Conditioned and Temporally Adaptive Visual Token ...
sources.snippet: We introduce FastVLA, a training-free, task-aware, and temporally adaptive visual token compression framework. At each step, FastVLA scores token importance via task-to-vision attention and adaptively sets the compression rate from the importance-distribution uniformity, measured by an inverse-Simpson metric with online sliding-window calibration.
